remarks: Experience an elevated lifestyle in this beautiful furnished corner apartment, where luxury meets convenience. Nestled within a classic elegant brick colonial building. Prime location; just seconds away from the fine shops and outstanding restaurants of Greenwich Ave and a short distance to the train. The light filled open floor plan blends classic elegance with modern functionality. This apartment has a gracious entryway and offers luxurious features, marble countertops, crown moldings, hardwood floors, custom cabinetry, new a/c, shiplap and more. The assigned parking provides convenience and ease. Parklike grounds and a courtyard surrounding the building create a serene and peaceful environment. Don't miss out the opportunity to rent this gem (heat and water included)!
